title: Dropdown
lead: Use the dropdown component to trigger a list of menu items when clicking on an element such as a button or link based on multiple styles, sizes, and placements with React

prose.text:
The dropdown component is a UI element built with React that displays a list of items when a trigger element (e.g., a button) is clicked. You can use it to build dropdown menus, lists, and more.

The default styles are built using utility classes from Tailwind CSS. You can customize the behavior and positioning of the dropdowns using custom props from React.

To start using the component make sure that you have imported it from Flowbite React:

prose.title: Default dropdown
prose.text: Use this example to create a simple dropdown with a list of menu items by adding child `<DropdownItem>` components inside the main `<Dropdown>` component.

prose.title: Dropdown divider
prose.text: Use the `<DropdownDivider>` component to add a divider between the dropdown items.

prose.title: Dropdown header
prose.text:
Use the `<DropdownHeader>` component to add a header to the dropdown. You can use this to add a user profile image and name, for example.

For more complex headers that include an `<input>` or `<TextInput>` control, set `enableTypeAhead` to `false` on the `<Dropdown>` to prevent keystrokes from being interpreted as item searches.

prose.title: Dropdown items with icon
prose.text: Add custom icons next to the menu items by using the `icon` prop on the `<DropdownItem>` component.

prose.title: Inline dropdown
prose.text: Use the `inline` prop to make the dropdown appear inline with the trigger element.

prose.title: Dropdown sizes
prose.text: You can use the `size` prop to change the size of the dropdown. The default size is `md`.

prose.title: Placement options
prose.text: Use the `placement` prop to change the placement of the dropdown by choosing one of the following options: `top`, `right`, `bottom` or `left`. If there is not enough space then the dropdown will be automatically repositioned.

prose.title: Click event handler
prose.text: Add a custom `onClick` event handler to the `<DropdownItem>` component to handle the click event.

prose.title: Custom trigger
prose.text: To customize the trigger element, you can use the `renderTrigger` property.

prose.title: Custom item
prose.text: To customize the `Dropdown.Item` base element you can use the `as` property.

prose.title: Theme
prose.text: To learn more about how to customize the appearance of components, please see the [Theme docs](/docs/customize/theme).
